content: DMCA safe harbor (protecting a hosting service from liability for user-uploaded infringing content) requires strict notice-and-takedown compliance, a registered designated agent, and no direct financial benefit from known infringement. A platform that itself extracts and stores copyrighted music clips (rather than just hosting user uploads) is on shakier ground for safe harbor than a pure UGC host, since the extraction is an affirmative act by the service, not passive hosting.
